lesson: electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts keeps journal.jsonl strictly append-only: undoneBy is derived at read time from each undo entry undoOf field, so no code may rewrite a past journal line.

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts registers only the `user` and `desktop` store roots in createMutations, so any project-scoped write (project skills, project settings layers) must add project roots there before a MutationPlan can name one.

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts resolveIn knows only the locator's fixed user and desktop roots; any project-scoped write must name a project:<dirName> store, resolved by the extraRoot callback createWorkspace passes to createMutations, which maps it to that project's .claude directory (never the project itself, ADR-0002).

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts trashPath must strip the colon out of a project:<dirName> store name before using it as a path segment - no Windows path segment may hold one, so any trash or write-displacement step in a project store fails without it.

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts now has a cross-store `copy` PlannedStep whose JournalStep carries `toStore`; anything reading a step's destination must use createdIn(step)/step.toStore rather than step.store, or it resolves the destination against the source's root.

electron/main/workspace/user-store.ts scanSkills covers only the user store and verified projects; plugin-shipped skills are deliberately absent, and the plugin skill scope plus its none(PLUGIN_OWNED) matrix row exist solely as the standing refusal for whoever surfaces them in the plugins view.
.claude/skills/run-kondo/ is committed and drives the real app against a fixture store, so a kondo UI change is checkable in minutes and must never be handed back as an unverified note.

electron/main/workspace/workspace.ts caches the session inventory for the process lifetime behind inventory(); any mutation that changes ~/.claude/projects must call dropInventory() or the next sessionProjects/tidyPreview replays the pre-mutation scan.

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts holds the only unlink in the app, emptyTrash(); it is deliberately unjournaled and nothing in mutate() or undo() calls it, so any future trash-clearing must go through that method rather than a step type.

kondo gitignores .claude/* (.gitignore:20), so a Claude Code hook registered in .claude/settings.json is per-machine only - the committed half has to live in a tracked file such as .jig/hooks/session-guards.cjs.

jig blocks any commit touching electron/main/workspace/** unless docs/domain.md is staged with it, and any commit touching shared/contract.ts unless some docs/adr/**/*.md is - budget the paired doc edit into the same commit rather than discovering it at commit time.

jig 2.7.1 hooks/jig-lib.js evalEdit ignores params.paths, but .jig/checks/run.mjs honours it (matchesAny against det.params.paths) - so a guard held in observe still blocks fully in the pre-commit and CI lanes.

scanMcpServers in electron/main/workspace/user-store.ts is the only reader of <project>/.mcp.json, and test/boundary.test.ts pins the outside-.claude path set as a literal so any second such file fails that assertion.

electron/main/workspace/sessions.ts now owns project location: scanSessionInventory unions ~/.claude.json registry keys with projects/ directories and computes guessedPath/pathExists/hasStore, and workspace.ts verifyProjects is a pure filter on hasStore rather than its own stat.

readPlacedDir in electron/main/workspace/user-store.ts is the one reader for both hand-placed shapes - a skills-style directory with SKILL.md and a single .md file - so scanSkills and scanPlacedEntries both go through it and a fifth placed kind needs only a PLACED_DIRS row plus a matrix row.

electron/main/workspace/workspace.ts context(c, parentId, only) narrows every kind scanner to one project by handing it a one-element VerifiedProject[], which is how projectDetail reads a single scope without a second set of scanners.

electron/main/workspace/mutations.ts: any write to ~/.claude.json or a settings file goes through the splice step and editMember in user-store.ts, never the whole-file write step - the write step discards concurrent changes and its undo restores a stale snapshot (ADR-0010).

electron/main/workspace/kinds.ts now dispatches by id prefix through its exported `listings` table (`listingForId` longest-match, `listingFor(kind, parentId)`); a new kind needs a row there plus a capability-matrix row, and no channel, workspace method or preload line.
Any change under electron/main/workspace/ is blocked at commit time by the jig guard workspace-adapter-outruns-domain-doc unless a docs/domain.md edit is staged in the same commit.

.claude/skills/run-kondo/SKILL.md still documents a Skills tab and a plugins view that src/app/app.tsx replaced with Projects/Clean up/History, and shared pluginSkills has no renderer consumer, so a UI check phrased around the plugins view has to be answered at the preload seam via window.kondo.pluginSkills instead.

jig 2.7.1 exports evaluateGuard, effectiveState, loadCheck, sessionDetectors, denyOf and checkProof from hooks/jig-lib.js, so a guard's before/after PostToolUse decision can be proved in-process against a cloned config with no file written and no .jig/ledger.jsonl row appended.

PLACEMENTS in electron/main/workspace/user-store.ts is the single per-kind placement table (dir, benched, suffix, inProject) for skills and the four placed kinds; kinds.ts placementOf() and movePlan() read from it, so nothing outside it may spell 'skills.disabled' or 'agents' again.

electron/main/workspace/user-store.ts scanSkills now takes SettingsLayer[] and resolves skillOverrides per scope chain (local>project>user); skills.disabled is kondo's own parking spot rather than a Claude convention, so SkillInfo.enabled needs both the directory and the override to agree.

electron/main/workspace/tidy.ts claims whole projects/<flat> trees before the per-file pass and skips every project it claimed, so category exclusivity is one `trees` Map rather than a check spread across categories; the precedence is the order of `tidyCategories` in shared/contract.ts.

electron/main/workspace/capabilities.ts: adding a member to CapabilityOperation widens Capabilities for every kind x scope row at once, and only the kinds whose plan() narrows request.op by hand (skill and plugin in kinds.ts) fail typecheck - every kind that forwards request.op to matrixRefusal accepts the new operation silently.

electron/main/workspace/user-store.ts readPluginManifest returns null for an unreadable or malformed installed_plugins.json and `{}` for an empty one, and every plugin reader must keep those two answers apart - null means kondo could not tell, `{}` means nothing is installed and all of plugins/data is residue.

electron/main/workspace/scan-cache.ts: ScanCache.get returns null for a miss, so a namespace whose cached value can legitimately be null must wrap it in an object (first-prompt stores { prompt }) or every empty transcript is re-streamed forever.

electron/main/workspace/user-store.ts: hooksFromLayers is async and takes the locator plus the verified projects (a hook script is resolved then statted), and armedHookScripts walks the same rawHooks() helper, so a hook's id index and the armed-script set can never describe different hooks.

docs/glossary.md now carries a UI-words table; every user-readable string lives in src/**, capabilities.ts refusal constants, and the journal summaries built by tidy.ts tidyPlan and kinds.ts — those last two render in History and the undo banner, so a wording change has to include them.

StoresOverview.sessions in shared/contract.ts now reports projectCount (the registry-plus-directories union) and transcriptProjectCount (members holding at least one session) as a pair, and the card that prints them is SessionCounts in src/features/projects/projects.tsx - there is no src/features/dashboard/.

kondo has no jsdom or testing-library, and test/ sits in tsconfig.electron.json which had no reference to tsconfig.app.json — so a view is only testable if its reading half is split into a plain module under src/features/<name>/, and tsconfig.electron.json now carries `references: [{path: ./tsconfig.app.json}]` to let test/ import it (TS6307 without it).

src/app/app.tsx declares four nav views (Projects, Clean up, Leftovers, History); drive.mjs open matches a button's whole text, so it reaches those four and never a project row, whose text carries count chips.

.claude/skills/run-kondo/drive.mjs: open matches whole text first then substring, pick finds a row as the widest ancestor of a <select> holding no other <select>, press matches by substring - so a UI check never needs an eval one-liner to reach a project row, a plugin move select or a button with a count suffix.

electron/main/workspace/display.ts: tildify (and the exported slashed) normalise every display path to forward slashes, including paths outside home; ProjectRow.label/path are display strings built through slashed in workspace.ts, while SessionProject.guessedPath stays the real OS path. A test asserting on a display path must wrap its expectation in slashed().

electron/main/workspace/workspace.ts: inventory() stats ~/.claude.json and projects/ (inventoryFingerprint) on every call and rebuilds when mtime or size changed, so a test that edits the registry between two api calls sees the change without a refresh flag; dropInventory() still covers kondo's own writes.

src/features/tidy/duplicate-rows.ts is the DOM-free reading half of the Skills kept twice section (verdictFor, keepReason, shortDigest) and is what test/duplicate-rows.test.ts pins; the component in duplicates.tsx renders under the sweep table in tidy.tsx, not as a nav destination.

electron/main/workspace/kinds.ts: skillTogglePlan writes skillOverrides through spliceMember and destinationLayer(layers, owner, speaks) is the one file-choosing policy for plugin and skill statements; a layer file not on disk is refused with needs-confirmation and the renderer retries entityMutate(id, {op, confirm: true}), so any new settings-writing toggle should reuse both rather than add a channel.

electron/main/workspace/tidy.ts: the whole-tree categories decide from name, location and ProjectRecord.hasMemory only; emptiness alone never makes a directory throwaway, and a test for a live memory-only directory needs guessExists to answer true for that one path.

electron/main/workspace/sessions.ts: a per-session companion file is recognised by a uuid regex in scanProject, attached by name on SessionRecord and queued beside the transcript in both tidy.ts (per-session paths) and kinds.ts sessionTrash; a companion without a transcript goes into ProjectRecord.orphanMarkers and tidy files it under orphan-sidecars with a stat for its size.

src/features/projects/project-rows.ts: listView(rows, {query, showFolded, limit}) is the one place deciding what the projects list renders; isFolded folds gone and throwaway rows, and ProjectRow.throwaway is computed main-side with the same isScratchProjectName the sweep uses, so a test fixture under os.tmpdir() reads as throwaway by design.

electron/main/workspace/kinds.ts: a write into ~/.claude.json is a splice step (store USER_CONFIG_STORE, at basename, expectDigest: digestSource(text), edits: [editMember(...)]) planned against a fresh fs.readFile of the registry, and the project's entry is found as the first key whose flattenProjectPath equals the flat name, never rebuilt from guessedPath (which is normalised).

electron/main/workspace/user-store.ts: inheritedSkills(skills, layers, owner) and projectLayers(layers, owner) are the per-project reading of a user-scope skill; the plan in kinds.ts (inheritedSkillTogglePlan) is reached when entityMutate carries a project:code: targetId on a skill id, and it needs the parsed SettingsLayer[] from context.layers(), not the seam's SettingsLayerInfo[].

.claude/skills/run-kondo/cdp.mjs is the one CDP client (findPage, waitForPage, connect -> evaluate/screenshot/waitFor); test/e2e/smoke.mjs imports the electron package's default export as the binary path and spawns it with the fixture's env, so a driver change lands there and drive.mjs follows.

electron/main/workspace/tidy.ts: a Candidate carries store (default user) and tidyPlan honours it, so a category over another mutation root (desktop) is a candidate list like any other; scanTidyCandidates returns {candidates, blocked} and TidyCategoryPreview.blocked is how a category says it cannot be swept right now. electron/main/workspace/scan.ts directorySize is one recursive readdir plus mapPool(64) stats, falling back to the stepwise walk when the tree cannot be listed whole.

package.json build block: electron-builder 26 packages the electron-vite out/ tree with files [out/**/*, package.json] and needs an author field for NSIS metadata; CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false plus mac.identity null keeps every OS unsigned, and test/e2e/smoke.mjs drives a packaged binary when KONDO_E2E_BINARY names one (no '.' argument then).

The v3 package-lock.json carries every @tailwindcss/oxide platform binary, so `npm ci` installs cleanly on ubuntu, windows and macos runners alike — the old `npm install` workaround comment in ci.yml was stale and is gone.
